newsitem.title: UK: NSM administrators complete sale of 3 units.
newsitem.headline: NSM administrators complete sale of 3 units.

text.p: The administrators of Britain's coal mining group NSM Plc on Wednesday announced they had completed the sale of three wholly-owned subsidiaries.

The three companies sold are Clee Hill Plant Ltd and open cast mining firms Coal Contractors and Fitzwise, all based in Chesterfield, northern England, administrators Murdoch McKillop, Alan Lewis and Richard Fleming of consultants Arthur Andersen said.
They were appointed in January after talks between banks and major shareholders over additional funding collapsed.
Coal Contractors has been bought by Hall Construction Services Ltd. The others were acquired by their respective management teams.
The completion follows Monday's announcement that Rackwood Mineral Holdings Plc had bought NSM's Welsh operations for 2.675 million stg.
